title: Helped me relax!
quote: Martin's workshop was certainly informative, and while it highlighted the most prominent traits we might exhibit in a workplace, the workshop also helped us understand how we could slightly alter the same, in order to adjust in a better way. For instance, having a higher rating on the "analytical" side, I always worry about small issues in my e-mails, etc., but the workshop, with Martin, and everyone else who faced the same problems as I did, I was able to gauge what I could do to avoid this stressful non-issue issue! (Thanks a ton, Martin!)
author: Rutvi Pandya
subject: Resilience
